commits.message:
Major Kotatsu-Redo port: tracker, reader, Cloudflare, library, sources and more (#137)

* fix(downloads): stop the queue dropping chapters and deleting other downloads' temp files

* fix(downloads): only clean up a download's own temp files

Concurrent downloads to the same storage dir deleted each other's temp files.
Ported from Kotatsu-Redo ddc4be1f1.

* fix(downloads): stop the queue silently dropping chapters

Queued downloads are enqueued as unique work per manga with KEEP, and the
scheduler only waited while a download was RUNNING. A second queue entry
for a manga whose earlier download was still ENQUEUED or BLOCKED (e.g.
waiting for charging or an unmetered network) was discarded by KEEP and
then removed from the queue, losing its chapters.

Leave such entries in the queue until the earlier download finishes, and
only remove an entry after its work has been stored.

* fix(backup): restore the selected sources instead of adding to them

A backup only holds the enabled sources, and restoring them was a plain
upsert, so every source already enabled stayed on. On a fresh install
that is the welcome sheet's language defaults (or the 15 fallback
defaults), so the restored selection was buried among them.

Unless merging, disable all sources before restoring the backed-up ones.

* fix(settings): restore float preferences from backups

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.1.

* fix(local): scan storage outside the index rebuild transaction

Holding the write connection during the scan stalled Room on cold start.
Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.5.

* fix(suggestions): keep the most relevant suggestions, not the least

The worker sorted ascending and kept the least relevant suggestions. The
notification picker also crashed with fewer than 3 suggestions
(Random.nextInt(0, 0)).

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.5.

* fix(details): hide NSFW related manga when NSFW content is disabled

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.7.

* feat(suggestions): rank by tag rarity and fall back to tags for related manga

* feat(suggestions): rank local suggestion tags by rarity

- Skip dropped manga (barely read, untouched for 3 weeks, not a
  favourite) when building the seed.
- Pick the reader's most telling tags by TF-IDF against tag frequency
  across the local database (TagStatistics, TagsDao.countMangaPerTag)
  instead of the most frequent ones; blacklisted tags are not seeds.
- Never search a source with no tag (its whole catalogue); search two
  matched tags together when supported, falling back to one.
- Prefer rating over popularity sort order.
- Suggestions are now enabled by default.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.5 (9fb36ac74), local parts only.

* fix(suggestions): keep suggestions off by default

Redo turned them on by default, which would start a background worker
hitting every enabled source for existing users who never opted in.

* feat(details): fall back to tag matching for related manga

When the source links fewer than four related titles, fill the row from
the reader's stored suggestions that share this manga's tags (weighted by
tag rarity), then from one search of the manga's source for its rarest
tags matched against the source's filter tags. NSFW and the tag blacklist
are respected; the source tag search is skipped for extension sources,
whose shared repository has stateful paging. The related list screen
uses the same use case.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.5 (9fb36ac74), without the community server.

* fix(webtoon): fix broken page sizing, page joins and pull-to-switch-chapter

* fix(webtoon): fix zero-height, infinite-scale and cut-off pages

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.3/9.8.5.

* fix(webtoon): rewrite pull-to-switch-chapter gesture

Replace the EdgeEffect-based pull effect with a touch tracker in
dispatchTouchEvent that only starts a pull when the list and the edge
page's inner image scroll are really at the first/last edge. The edge
glow is disabled while the gesture is enabled. The feedback chip now
fades from 0.15 to full alpha and switches to an outlined background
once the threshold is reached, and hides immediately on release.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 45455ee18.

* fix(webtoon): stop pages being cut off at page joins

Walk every page a scroll reaches instead of only the first two, so a
fast fling over short pages can no longer carry a tall page past the
viewport edge with its image unscrolled. Re-pin all pages' inner scroll
after every layout (decode, zoom, rotation), and place a page that
finishes decoding after the list has already scrolled it partly off
screen without jumping to its end or moving what is on screen.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.5 (9fb36ac74).

* fix(tracker): correct new-chapter counting and stop resetting tracks

* fix(tracker): stop resetting tracks shared by history and favourites, page past update-disabled sources

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.0/9.8.1.

* fix(tracker): credit chapters released since the last tracked chapter

Opening the reader on an older chapter advanced last_chapter_id to the
newest chapter without counting chapters released since the previous
check, so they never showed up in Updates. Also cap the stored new
chapters counter at the branch chapter count.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): fall back to date and history anchors when comparing

When the tracked last chapter id is no longer in the fresh chapter list
(sources rotating chapter urls), compare by the last chapter upload date,
then by the history chapter, and only then re-baseline silently. The
first check of a track anchors on the history chapter instead of
swallowing chapters released since the user last read.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d) / 9.7.8 (f34b597c1).

* fix(tracker): drop already read and stale chapters from updates

Chapters at or before the reading position (also taking similar-titled
manga read from another source into account) or uploaded more than 90
days ago are not reported as new. Adds HistoryRepository.findSimilarByTitle.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.8 (f34b597c1) / 9.8.1 (cb430d3a6).

* fix(tracker): skip long inactive tracks and clear stale counters

Tracks without a chapter, read or favourite in the last 90 days are left
out of regular checks but still re-checked weekly, so a hiatus series is
not excluded forever. Unread counters of tracks whose last chapter is
older than 90 days are cleared on gc.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.8 (f34b597c1) / 9.8.0 (b1483ebdd).

* fix(tracker): rebase tracks on the history chapter when clearing counters

Clearing all updates now also resets last_chapter_id to the history
chapter (or 0 when there is none), so the tracker recomputes unread
chapters from the reading position.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): treat manual checks as full runs without foreground service

A manually triggered one-shot check now checks every track even when the
system refuses to promote the worker to a foreground service.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): one-shot migration for tracks advanced past unread chapters

The reader-side new chapters check used to move last_chapter_id to the
newest chapter without crediting chapters the user had not read. On first
start with network, credit chapters after the history chapter for tracks
with no new chapters whose history differs from last_chapter_id, then
refresh history chapter counts of tracks with new chapters so they no
longer show as completed. Gated by two SharedPreferences flags; no DB
schema change.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d) / 9.8.0 (b1483ebdd).

* feat(feed): swipe to remove a feed item, with undo

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.3 (77d993d92).

* feat(tracker): auto-download new chapters of recently read manga

* feat(tracker): auto-download new chapters of recently read manga

Adds a "Recently read manga" tracker download strategy: new chapters of
manga read within the last 30 days are downloaded whether or not
anything is saved locally. For both strategies, at most the 5 newest
not yet downloaded chapters are taken per manga per run, and nothing is
queued when the target storage has less than 2 GB free or the download
storage quota is already reached (the worker would otherwise evict
older chapters).

Tracker downloads now go through the download queue instead of straight
to the download worker, so the Wi-Fi, charging and off-peak settings
apply to them as to smart downloads.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.3 (77d993d92).

* fix(tracker): keep downloading every new chapter of downloaded manga

The 5-chapter cap from the recently-read strategy also hit the existing
downloaded-manga strategy, and chapters over the cap were never offered
again. Only cap the new recently-read strategy.

* perf(tracker): per-source limits, stop at blocked sources, save fixes

* fix(tracker): refresh progress outside the save transaction, date the tracked branch

saveUpdates recalculated reading progress inside its database
transaction, and that can load the chapter pages from the network: a
slow source kept the transaction open for the whole request. The track
and its feed entry are now saved first and the progress refreshed
after; a failed refresh no longer fails a check that was already saved.

When no new chapter has an upload date, lastChapterDate() fell back to
the last chapter across every branch instead of the tracked one.

* perf(tracker): limit per-source checks and stop at blocked sources

The tracker ran up to 6 checks at a time with no regard for the source,
so one source could take every slot, and a Cloudflare-protected or
rate-limited source failed once for each of its manga in the batch.

- At most 2 checks run per source. The source permit is taken before
  the global one, so a busy source does not hold global slots while
  its own checks wait.
- The first Cloudflare or rate-limit (429) failure of a source stops it
  for the rest of the run: its other manga are not requested, and are
  stamped as checked with that failure in one update, so a blocked
  source still cannot fill the following batches.
- Captcha failures are stored as a new result, RESULT_CAPTCHA, so they
  can be found again once the captcha is solved. The tracker debug
  screen shows them like failures.
- The captcha notification also finds a Cloudflare error wrapped in
  another exception.

* feat(tracker): re-check captcha-blocked manga after a solve

Manga whose check stopped at a Cloudflare captcha used to wait for
their next turn in the queue, up to a full tracking cycle, even after
the captcha was solved.

CaptchaHandler now reports each solve, whether automatic or from the
captcha notification, through solvedSources. Swiping the notification
away is not a solve. WorkScheduleManager listens and queues one
re-check per source: a one-time TrackWorker run that checks only the
tracks of that source stored as RESULT_CAPTCHA. A re-check already
waiting or running for the source is kept.

It cannot loop. A re-check that meets the captcha again only shows the
captcha notification, and only another solve queues a new one.

On by default: "Re-check after solving a CAPTCHA" in the tracker
settings.

* fix(cloudflare): keep WebView interception alive and remember the clearance User-Agent

* fix(webview): make request interception survive Cloudflare interstitials

Re-inject the page script on every navigation and poll it every 250 ms
while capturing, instead of injecting it once (captures used to time out
when a challenge page preceded the real one). Serialise captures with a
mutex and reuse a single WebView, releasing it asynchronously instead of
synchronously destroying it. Evaluation WebViews in WebViewExecutor are
now destroyed after use, and evaluateJs uses cancellation-safe
suspendCancellableCoroutine.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.2 (dc0de752a).

* fix(cloudflare): remember the User-Agent that earned clearance per source

When the CloudFlare solver WebView is given a non-Android (e.g. hard-coded
desktop) User-Agent that contradicts the engine, realign it with the
engine's default UA so Turnstile can pass, and once the check passes
store it in SourceSettings.cloudFlareUserAgent. CommonHeadersInterceptor
then forces that UA for the source, so OkHttp presents the agent the
cf_clearance cookie is bound to. The background WebViewExecutor solver
uses the same stored UA.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.1 (cb430d3a6).

* fix(cloudflare): let the user's User-Agent setting win over the stored clearance agent

The agent recorded after a Cloudflare solve was never cleared and silently
overrode a User-Agent the user had configured for the source. Record the
user's setting alongside it and ignore the stored agent once that changes.

* feat(cloudflare): solve captchas automatically on explicit actions (experimental, off by default)

Opening a catalog, a manga or a chapter now first tries to pass a
CloudFlare challenge silently: a translucent, focused
CloudFlareHiddenActivity loads the challenge and a read-only JS
page-state probe (CF_STATE_JS) decides when the real page is shown.
CaptchaAutoResolveCoordinator owns the single session (de-duplicated,
30 s success / 3 min failure cooldowns, cancelled when the app goes to
background, never started from background). CloudFlareActivity gets the
resolve loop with viewport wait, stable-pass counting, one auto-recreate
with a cleared clearance and a reveal for manual completion; the visible
solver uses the same loop. ChaptersLoader and PageLoader run through
runWithVerification (prefetch never starts a solve), the reader retries
loading details after a solve and the catalog shows "Solving captcha
automatically…". Background workers and coil errors never auto-solve.
New per-source opt-out "Disable automatic CAPTCHA solving".

The headless WebViewExecutor.tryResolveCaptcha and its
CaptchaContinuationClient / ContinuationResumeWebViewClient are removed:
CaptchaHandler was their only user and it now delegates to the
coordinator. AdBlock is kept.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4-9.8.3 (eb2dd236d, d4bb9aff6, c24bd1bb0,
b1483ebdd, cb430d3a6, 77d993d92).

Automatic solving is experimental and off by default: a global switch
in the network settings, "Solve CAPTCHAs automatically (experimental)".
SourceSettings.isCaptchaAutoResolveDisabled reads it as well as the
per-source opt-out, so every caller follows it: the solver itself, the
catalog and the details screen. The per-source switch is greyed out
while the global one is off.

* fix(history): drop the leading "-" from reading progress badges

The "percent left" and "chapters left" badges no longer show a minus sign.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.2 (b81c17402).

* feat(shortcuts): hide NSFW manga from launcher shortcuts

Adds a "Hide NSFW from shortcuts" toggle (on by default); NSFW titles
are also skipped whenever NSFW content is disabled globally.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.3 (77d993d92).

* fix(history): keep the reading position across chapter id changes and smart resume

* fix(history): keep the reading position when a source changes chapter ids

Some sources derive chapter ids from data that changes between loads.

chapter of the new list (same url/branch, else same volume and number,
else same url). Saving history maps a stale chapter id the same way.

last one at the reader's last save, which it reads from
history.chaptersCount. The ported progress recalculation (run when details
open and when the tracker finds new chapters) and the one-shot tracker
migration both overwrote that count with the current total, so after a new
release Continue reopened the finished chapter instead.

estimate for a vanished chapter id still updates it, since it scales the
percent by the old count and smart resume does not apply there.

that two chapters never share a spread, and optionally show the first
page of each chapter alone ("First page as cover (solo)" in the reader
config sheet). Adapter positions are mapped back to the real page
positions for the page counter, slider jumps, saved state and history;
the reversed reader now pads in reading order and reverses afterwards so
spreads stay identical in RTL. Toggling the cover option re-lays out the

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.1 (32b29231f).

* feat(reader): zoom double-page spreads as a whole, push pages together

and pan over the whole spread (DoublePageScalingFrame), center each page
against the other one of its spread instead of the screen edges, and let
wide images (aspect ratio above 1.3) span the full spread.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.0 (cf3625d36) and 9.7.1 (32b29231f).

* feat(reader): E-Ink flash on page change

* feat(reader): E-Ink flash on page change

Optional full-screen white or black flash on page change to clear E-Ink
ghosting, with configurable duration and frequency (every N pages).
Page changes are counted once the reader has settled (150 ms), using the
reader's own position: one per page in the pagers, one per spread in the
double-page reader (spacer pages excluded), one per centre page in
webtoon mode. Restoring the position on open, switching reader mode and
webtoon autoscroll do not flash.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.8 (f34b597c1).

* Don't resume a manual new-chapters check hours later

A manual check now checks every track even when it can't run in the
foreground. As plain background work, a large library can run into
the job time limit or doze, and WorkManager then re-queues the
request and starts it again from scratch later. With the tracker set
to manual, that shows up as an automatic check hours after the user
asked for one.

Stamp manual requests and skip a run that only starts more than 30
minutes after it was requested. Also let the progress notification
time out, so a worker killed before its finally block can't leave it
stuck, usually at 100%.

* Close the captcha screen without waiting for the solve to be recorded

finishSuccess() ran discard() in the Activity's scope and closed only
once it returned. discard() waits for the captcha lock and rebuilds
the remaining captcha notifications, favicons included, so the screen
could stay open on the solved page. Tapping X then destroyed the
Activity, which cancelled discard(): the source stayed marked as
captcha-protected and the tracker re-check never ran.

Close right away and record the solve in the process scope instead.
Also bound each page probe, so a WebView that never answers
evaluateJavascript can't stall the loop, and log challenge state
changes to make failed solves diagnosable.

* Let the captcha re-check wait for a running check to finish

A check that runs into a captcha skips the rest of that source and
records those tracks as blocked only when it ends. Solving the captcha
before then started the re-check right away: it found just the track
that hit the captcha, and the running check then marked the rest of
the source as blocked, leaving them for another solve.

While another check is running, retry the re-check a minute later,
up to 15 times, instead of starting it.

* Ride out short rate limits instead of skipping the rest of the source

A single "too many requests" made the tracker skip every remaining
manga of that source for the rest of the run, even when the server
only asked to wait a few seconds: with WeebCentral, 25 of 37 manga
were skipped on every manual check, and stamped as checked.

When the wait is under a minute, pace the source instead: wait it out
plus 10%, then check its manga one at a time, a few seconds apart,
retrying a manga that is rate limited again. Only a long wait, three
rate limits for one manga or more than five minutes of waiting in
total still block the source for the run.

* Keep new chapters after the last checked one whatever their date

The tracker drops "new" chapters uploaded more than 90 days ago, so a
first check anchored on the reading position or a date doesn't report
a whole backlog. It applied that rule to every check, though, and the
track still moves past what it drops: on a source that gives old or
wrong upload dates, a chapter that really appeared since the previous
check was hidden for good.

Only apply the age limit when the comparison doesn't start from the
chapter the previous check ended on. Already-read chapters are still
dropped either way.

* Clear unread counters without rewinding the tracks

Clearing the Updates feed with "reset counters" also moved every
track's baseline back to the reading position, or dropped it when
there was no history. The next check then reported every chapter
after the reading position as new again, across the whole library,
and the age filter quietly hid most of them.

Only reset the counters, as before.

commits.message:
feat(cloudflare): solve captchas automatically on explicit actions (experimental, off by default)

Opening a catalog, a manga or a chapter now first tries to pass a
CloudFlare challenge silently: a translucent, focused
CloudFlareHiddenActivity loads the challenge and a read-only JS
page-state probe (CF_STATE_JS) decides when the real page is shown.
CaptchaAutoResolveCoordinator owns the single session (de-duplicated,
30 s success / 3 min failure cooldowns, cancelled when the app goes to
background, never started from background). CloudFlareActivity gets the
resolve loop with viewport wait, stable-pass counting, one auto-recreate
with a cleared clearance and a reveal for manual completion; the visible
solver uses the same loop. ChaptersLoader and PageLoader run through
runWithVerification (prefetch never starts a solve), the reader retries
loading details after a solve and the catalog shows "Solving captcha
automatically…". Background workers and coil errors never auto-solve.
New per-source opt-out "Disable automatic CAPTCHA solving".

The headless WebViewExecutor.tryResolveCaptcha and its
CaptchaContinuationClient / ContinuationResumeWebViewClient are removed:
CaptchaHandler was their only user and it now delegates to the
coordinator. AdBlock is kept.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4-9.8.3 (eb2dd236d, d4bb9aff6, c24bd1bb0,
b1483ebdd, cb430d3a6, 77d993d92).

Automatic solving is experimental and off by default: a global switch
in the network settings, "Solve CAPTCHAs automatically (experimental)".
SourceSettings.isCaptchaAutoResolveDisabled reads it as well as the
per-source opt-out, so every caller follows it: the solver itself, the
catalog and the details screen. The per-source switch is greyed out
while the global one is off.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
fix(cloudflare): keep WebView interception alive and remember the clearance User-Agent

* fix(webview): make request interception survive Cloudflare interstitials

Re-inject the page script on every navigation and poll it every 250 ms
while capturing, instead of injecting it once (captures used to time out
when a challenge page preceded the real one). Serialise captures with a
mutex and reuse a single WebView, releasing it asynchronously instead of
synchronously destroying it. Evaluation WebViews in WebViewExecutor are
now destroyed after use, and evaluateJs uses cancellation-safe
suspendCancellableCoroutine.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.2 (dc0de752a).

* fix(cloudflare): remember the User-Agent that earned clearance per source

When the CloudFlare solver WebView is given a non-Android (e.g. hard-coded
desktop) User-Agent that contradicts the engine, realign it with the
engine's default UA so Turnstile can pass, and once the check passes
store it in SourceSettings.cloudFlareUserAgent. CommonHeadersInterceptor
then forces that UA for the source, so OkHttp presents the agent the
cf_clearance cookie is bound to. The background WebViewExecutor solver
uses the same stored UA.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.1 (cb430d3a6).

* fix(cloudflare): let the user's User-Agent setting win over the stored clearance agent

The agent recorded after a Cloudflare solve was never cleared and silently
overrode a User-Agent the user had configured for the source. Record the
user's setting alongside it and ignore the stored agent once that changes.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
feat(tracker): re-check captcha-blocked manga after a solve

Manga whose check stopped at a Cloudflare captcha used to wait for
their next turn in the queue, up to a full tracking cycle, even after
the captcha was solved.

CaptchaHandler now reports each solve, whether automatic or from the
captcha notification, through solvedSources. Swiping the notification
away is not a solve. WorkScheduleManager listens and queues one
re-check per source: a one-time TrackWorker run that checks only the
tracks of that source stored as RESULT_CAPTCHA. A re-check already
waiting or running for the source is kept.

It cannot loop. A re-check that meets the captcha again only shows the
captcha notification, and only another solve queues a new one.

On by default: "Re-check after solving a CAPTCHA" in the tracker
settings.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
perf(tracker): per-source limits, stop at blocked sources, save fixes

* fix(tracker): refresh progress outside the save transaction, date the tracked branch

saveUpdates recalculated reading progress inside its database
transaction, and that can load the chapter pages from the network: a
slow source kept the transaction open for the whole request. The track
and its feed entry are now saved first and the progress refreshed
after; a failed refresh no longer fails a check that was already saved.

When no new chapter has an upload date, lastChapterDate() fell back to
the last chapter across every branch instead of the tracked one.

* perf(tracker): limit per-source checks and stop at blocked sources

The tracker ran up to 6 checks at a time with no regard for the source,
so one source could take every slot, and a Cloudflare-protected or
rate-limited source failed once for each of its manga in the batch.

- At most 2 checks run per source. The source permit is taken before
  the global one, so a busy source does not hold global slots while
  its own checks wait.
- The first Cloudflare or rate-limit (429) failure of a source stops it
  for the rest of the run: its other manga are not requested, and are
  stamped as checked with that failure in one update, so a blocked
  source still cannot fill the following batches.
- Captcha failures are stored as a new result, RESULT_CAPTCHA, so they
  can be found again once the captcha is solved. The tracker debug
  screen shows them like failures.
- The captcha notification also finds a Cloudflare error wrapped in
  another exception.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
feat(tracker): auto-download new chapters of recently read manga

* feat(tracker): auto-download new chapters of recently read manga

Adds a "Recently read manga" tracker download strategy: new chapters of
manga read within the last 30 days are downloaded whether or not
anything is saved locally. For both strategies, at most the 5 newest
not yet downloaded chapters are taken per manga per run, and nothing is
queued when the target storage has less than 2 GB free or the download
storage quota is already reached (the worker would otherwise evict
older chapters).

Tracker downloads now go through the download queue instead of straight
to the download worker, so the Wi-Fi, charging and off-peak settings
apply to them as to smart downloads.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.3 (77d993d92).

* fix(tracker): keep downloading every new chapter of downloaded manga

The 5-chapter cap from the recently-read strategy also hit the existing
downloaded-manga strategy, and chapters over the cap were never offered
again. Only cap the new recently-read strategy.

commits.message:
fix(tracker): correct new-chapter counting and stop resetting tracks

* fix(tracker): stop resetting tracks shared by history and favourites, page past update-disabled sources

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.8.0/9.8.1.

* fix(tracker): credit chapters released since the last tracked chapter

Opening the reader on an older chapter advanced last_chapter_id to the
newest chapter without counting chapters released since the previous
check, so they never showed up in Updates. Also cap the stored new
chapters counter at the branch chapter count.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): fall back to date and history anchors when comparing

When the tracked last chapter id is no longer in the fresh chapter list
(sources rotating chapter urls), compare by the last chapter upload date,
then by the history chapter, and only then re-baseline silently. The
first check of a track anchors on the history chapter instead of
swallowing chapters released since the user last read.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d) / 9.7.8 (f34b597c1).

* fix(tracker): drop already read and stale chapters from updates

Chapters at or before the reading position (also taking similar-titled
manga read from another source into account) or uploaded more than 90
days ago are not reported as new. Adds HistoryRepository.findSimilarByTitle.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.8 (f34b597c1) / 9.8.1 (cb430d3a6).

* fix(tracker): skip long inactive tracks and clear stale counters

Tracks without a chapter, read or favourite in the last 90 days are left
out of regular checks but still re-checked weekly, so a hiatus series is
not excluded forever. Unread counters of tracks whose last chapter is
older than 90 days are cleared on gc.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.8 (f34b597c1) / 9.8.0 (b1483ebdd).

* fix(tracker): rebase tracks on the history chapter when clearing counters

Clearing all updates now also resets last_chapter_id to the history
chapter (or 0 when there is none), so the tracker recomputes unread
chapters from the reading position.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): treat manual checks as full runs without foreground service

A manually triggered one-shot check now checks every track even when the
system refuses to promote the worker to a foreground service.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d).

* fix(tracker): one-shot migration for tracks advanced past unread chapters

The reader-side new chapters check used to move last_chapter_id to the
newest chapter without crediting chapters the user had not read. On first
start with network, credit chapters after the history chapter for tracks
with no new chapters whose history differs from last_chapter_id, then
refresh history chapter counts of tracks with new chapters so they no
longer show as completed. Gated by two SharedPreferences flags; no DB
schema change.

Ported from Kotatsu-Redo 9.7.4 (eb2dd236d) / 9.8.0 (b1483ebdd).
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
fix(webtoon): fix broken page sizing, page joins and pull-to-switch-chapter

* fix(webtoon): rewrite pull-to-switch-chapter gesture

Replace the EdgeEffect-based pull effect with a touch tracker in

page's inner image scroll are really at the first/last edge. The edge
glow is disabled while the gesture is enabled. The feedback chip now

commits.message:
fix(downloads): stop the queue dropping chapters and deleting other downloads' temp files

* fix(downloads): only clean up a download's own temp files

Concurrent downloads to the same storage dir deleted each other's temp files.
Ported from Kotatsu-Redo ddc4be1f1.

* fix(downloads): stop the queue silently dropping chapters

Queued downloads are enqueued as unique work per manga with KEEP, and the
scheduler only waited while a download was RUNNING. A second queue entry
for a manga whose earlier download was still ENQUEUED or BLOCKED (e.g.
waiting for charging or an unmetered network) was discarded by KEEP and
then removed from the queue, losing its chapters.

Leave such entries in the queue until the earlier download finishes, and
only remove an entry after its work has been stored.

Extract visible page resolution and test the prepend scenario

Move the adapter position checks and the lookup of visible pages in the
view model content into pure functions, so the stale-position case can be
unit tested without a fragment or view model.

The tests cover a position reported by the adapter after the previous
chapter was prepended, NO_POSITION, a double-page spread ending past the
last page, reversed modes and pages that are no longer loaded.

Also correct the onCurrentPageChanged KDoc: pages are matched by chapter
and page index, not by identity.

commits.message:
Ignore NO_POSITION instead of clamping it to the first page

The double-page scroll listener reports NO_POSITION (-1) when nothing is
laid out, for example while the reader is resized to zero. Clamping it to
0 resolved to the first page of the earliest loaded chapter, which could
then be saved to history as the reading progress and also triggered an
unneeded load of the previous chapter.

Drop updates with a negative position and clamp only the upper bound,
which a double-page spread ending on the last page can exceed by one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FVCWk6dfgPw4JbUGTiRppj
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
Keep reader history saves from landing out of order (#119)

Each reader progress save runs as its own coroutine, and its transaction
also rewrites chapters and updates tracking, so two saves requested
milliseconds apart could reach the database in either order. A stale
position (such as the one fixed in the previous commit) could then
overwrite the correction made right after it and stay in history.

Take a sequence number when a save is requested and skip writing any
save older than one already written for that manga, so the newest
request always wins.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
Fix reader saving previous chapter's first page as progress

Page change callbacks reported adapter positions, which the view model
resolved against its latest content. The adapter applies content
asynchronously, so after the previous chapter was prepended a stale
position (e.g. page 1 of chapter 39) resolved to page 1 of chapter 38,
and the chapter change was immediately saved to history.

Resolve the visible pages from the adapter's own items and look them up
by identity in the view model instead.
commits.author: PoonHarpoon

commits.message:
fix(browser): hide spinner on main-frame load errors in BrowserClient (#68)

BrowserClient flips BrowserCallback.onLoadingStateChanged on
onPageStarted (true) and onPageFinished (false), but does not
override onReceivedError. On many failure modes (DNS, certificate,
offline, 4xx/5xx) onPageFinished does not always fire after the
error, so the toolbar / progress UI stays stuck on isLoading = true
even though the page never loaded.

Add a main-frame-only onReceivedError override that flips
isLoading = false too. isForMainFrame keeps a single blocked
sub-resource from flipping the spinner off while the main load is
still running.

commits.message:
feat(settings): Add "Every 6 hours" option for periodic backups

Adds a new "Every 6 hours" frequency option to the periodic backup settings.

To maintain consistency with the existing preference values, which are stored in days, this new option is represented internally as a fractional value of `0.25` days.

The implementation includes:
- Adding the new string resource and updating the preference arrays.
- Changing the preference type in `AppSettings.kt` from `Long` to `Float` to accommodate the fractional value.
- Updating the millisecond conversion logic to correctly calculate the interval from a float value in days.

This approach avoids a complex data migration and is simpler and safer than changing the base unit for all values from days to hours.
commits.author: google-labs-jules[bot]

commits.message:
feat: Add saved filters to backup and restore

This commit adds support for backing up and restoring saved filters.

- Added a new `SAVED_FILTERS` section to the backup process.
- Implemented the logic to read filters from SharedPreferences during backup and write them back during restore.
- Fixed compilation errors in `AppBackupAgent` and `BackupSectionModel`.

commits.message:
Fix(reader): Fix incorrect scaling for short images in webtoon reader

When an image in the webtoon reader is shorter than the screen height, it was being incorrectly scaled, causing it to appear zoomed in or cropped.

This was caused by the `scrollTo` function in `WebtoonImageView.kt` calling `resetScaleAndCenter()` for images with a scroll range of zero. This method, from the underlying SubsamplingScaleImageView library, resets the image to a default scale instead of using the custom logic required by the reader.

The fix replaces the call to `resetScaleAndCenter()` with `scrollToInternal(0)`. This ensures that the custom scaling logic, which fits the image to the screen width, is applied consistently to all images, regardless of their height.

commits.message:
Fix page position loss when switching reader modes

- Compare content.state with getCurrentState() to detect configuration changes vs intentional updates
- Use content.state when they match (mode switch case) to preserve explicit state updates
- Use getCurrentState() when they differ (rotation case) to restore saved position
- This ensures both screen rotation and mode switching work correctly

Co-authored-by: NathanBap <101987516+NathanBap@users.noreply.github.com>
commits.author: Copilot

commits.message:
Fix screen rotation causing reader to jump back to initial page

- Modified BaseReaderFragment to always use getCurrentState() when available
- getCurrentState() contains the most recent reading position saved in onPause/onDestroyView
- content.state may contain the initial state from when content was first loaded
- This ensures the current page position is preserved across configuration changes like screen rotation

Co-authored-by: NathanBap <101987516+NathanBap@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.message:
Improve edge detection performance (#1457)

* Optimize edge detection by decoding full image once

Refactors edge detection to decode the entire image at a downscaled resolution once, instead of decoding multiple regions. This improves performance by reducing repeated decoding operations and leverages direct pixel access for edge analysis. Adds a scale factor calculation to balance accuracy and speed for large images.

commits.message:
Switch per language support to manual

The current automatic support setup has a bug where the app language will change for users with Android 15 when there is a configuration change like rotating a screen. It seems that that using generateLocaleConfig on AGP 8.8+ triggers a bug in Android 15 (android:defaultLocale) which causes this issue

Give "Complete" status only to fully completed Manga
